title: 第一卷 人生初见 第十九章 身骑白马第一卷 人生初见 第二十章 灰色沙地
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
长孙抱着倒在怀里的初黎，一时手足无措，心乱如麻。
“初黎，你吐出来，你快吐出来。”
初黎躺在长孙怀里，看着长孙因为关切而慌乱的眼神，就像是小时候，长孙做错了事怕被母亲责怪跑到初黎这里求保护时一模一样。
“少爷，对不起，我忍受不了被遗忘的痛苦，这样的痛苦我已经经历了一次。请你原谅我这次选择忘了你。”初黎虚弱的说道。
“不要，不要，初黎，你吐出来，你肯定是含到了嘴里，骗我的对不对，就像是小时候你抢我好吃的一样，你没有咽下去，你会吐出来给我的对不对。”长孙此刻紧张的像个孩子。
“呵呵，少爷，初黎好开心你还记得这些。这些年你承受了太多的痛苦，初黎想你答应我一个自私的请求，请你记得这些快乐的回忆，把我的那份也珍藏起来。”
初黎被长孙的话勾起了以前的回忆，笑了一声，但却那么的无力。
“华夫人，你有解药的对不对，你给我，我愿意给你做牛做马，你要我怎样都行…”长孙跪着爬到华夫人面前，抓着华夫人的衣襟哭着说道。
华夫人看着眼前的长孙，不知想起了什么，刚才的残忍、冷酷竟消失的无影无踪，结巴的说道：“没…没有…解药。”
长孙恍若遭受了晴天霹雳一般，跌坐在地上。
直到听到初黎的咳声，长孙才急忙爬到初黎身旁，将初黎抱在怀里，眼中说不出的痛苦。
……
“你为什么叫初黎？”小男孩问。
“因为夫人是在太阳初升，黎明之时捡到我的，所以我叫初黎。夫人说黎明给了我重生，只要有黎明就会有希望。只要初黎在，就永远跟着少爷。”小女孩这样对小男孩承诺。
……
“初黎初黎，我把娘亲的手镯打碎了，怎么办啊？”小男孩一脸紧张的问小女孩。
“少爷不要急，待会夫人回来，就说是我打碎的就好了。”小女孩一把将小男孩护在身后。
……
“是谁打碎了我的镯子啊？”女子问道。
“夫人，是我打碎的。”小女孩护着身后的小男孩。

女子看着两个小孩，小男孩紧张的目光闪躲。
女子见此情景心中已经有了答案，说道：“是初黎啊，没有伤到哪里吧？下次要小心，别划伤了手。”
小女孩乖巧的称是，小男孩却不高兴了，立马站出来，大喊道：“娘亲不公平，初黎打碎了镯子你就关心她，我打碎了镯子就要被打屁股。”
“哦？你打碎了镯子，在哪里啊？”女子被小男孩逗笑。
“我…我…这个镯子是我打碎的…反正娘亲就是偏心，喜欢初黎不喜欢我。你们都是一样，喜欢初黎不喜欢我。”小男孩不小心说了实话，然后委屈的扭过身去。
女子看着生气的小男孩，忍俊不禁。
小女孩则跑到小男孩面前，抱住小男孩。
“初黎喜欢少爷。”
……
“初黎，收拾东西，我们走，这个家容不下我，那我也懒得在这个家多待。”少年一进门便愤怒的喊道。
“少爷，怎么了？”少女见少年气冲冲的冲进来。
“他们想要废了我继承人的身份，爷爷竟然沉默不语，沉默就是默认了，这个家我已经没什么好留恋的了。既然他们都想让我走，那我就闯出一番名堂让他们看看。”少年愤慨的说道。
少女收拾好东西，两人偷偷的离开了家族。
……
“初黎，这里能住人么？”少年看着贫民窟，掩鼻问道。
“少爷，我们出门没带钱，现在只能住这里了。”少女解释道。
“好…好吧，那初黎你把我送到这，你就回去吧，这太简陋了，你一个女孩子家怎么能住在这。”
“初黎哪里都不会去，少爷在哪里，初黎就在哪里，只要初黎在，就永远跟着少爷。”少女这样对少年承诺。
……
曾经的一幕幕，此刻无比清晰的呈现在长孙眼前。
content_en:
The eldest grandson held Chu Li who fell in his arms, feeling at a loss and confused.
"Chu Li, spit it out, spit it out quickly."
Chu Li lay in the arms of the eldest grandson, looking at the eldest grandson's panicked eyes because of concern, just like when he was a child, when the eldest grandson did something wrong and was afraid of being blamed by his mother, he ran to Chu Li for protection.
"Master, I'm sorry, I can't bear the pain of being forgotten. I have already experienced this pain once. Please forgive me for choosing to forget you this time." Chu Li said weakly.
"No, no, Chu Li, if you spit it out, you must have put it in your mouth. You lied to me, right? It's like when you robbed me of delicious food when I was a child. If you didn't swallow it, you would spit it out to me, right?" Zhangsun was as nervous as a child at this moment.
"Haha, Master, Chu Li is so happy that you still remember these. You have endured too much pain over the years. Chu Li wants you to agree to a selfish request of mine. Please remember these happy memories and treasure mine."
Chu Li laughed because Zhang Sun's words brought back memories of the past, but she was so weak.
"Mrs. Hua, do you have the antidote? Give it to me. I am willing to make cows and horses for you. I will do whatever you want..." The eldest grandson crawled to Mrs. Hua on his knees, grabbed the skirt of Mrs. Hua's clothes and cried.
Mrs. Hua looked at her eldest grandson in front of her and remembered something. The cruelty and coldness just now disappeared without a trace, and she stammered: "No... no... antidote."
The eldest grandson fell to the ground as if he had been struck by a bolt from the blue.
It wasn't until he heard Chu Li's cough that the eldest grandson hurriedly crawled to Chu Li's side and held Chu Li in his arms, with unspeakable pain in his eyes.
…
"Why are you called Chu Li?" the little boy asked.
"Because my wife picked me up at dawn when the sun was rising, I called me Chu Li. My wife said that dawn gave me a new life. As long as there is dawn, there will be hope. As long as Chu Li is here, I will always follow the young master." The little girl promised the little boy.
…
"Chuli Chuli, I broke my mother's bracelet, what should I do?" the little boy asked the little girl nervously.
"Master, don't be anxious. When my wife comes back later, just say that I broke it." The little girl protected the little boy behind her.
…
"Who broke my bracelet?" the woman asked.
"Madam, I broke it." The little girl protected the little boy behind her.
The woman looked at the two children, and the little boy ducked nervously.
Seeing this scene, the woman already had the answer in her mind and said, "It's Chuli. It's not hurt anywhere, right? Be careful next time so as not to scratch your hand."
The little girl said yes obediently, but the little boy was unhappy. He immediately stood up and shouted: "Mom, it's not fair. If Chuli breaks the bracelet, you care about her. If I break the bracelet, I will be spanked."
"Oh? You broke the bracelet, where is it?" The woman was amused by the little boy.
"I...I...I broke this bracelet...Anyway, my mother is partial. She likes Chu Li but doesn't like me. You are all the same, you like Chu Li but don't like me." The little boy accidentally told the truth, and then turned away in grievance.
The woman looked at the angry little boy and couldn't help laughing.
The little girl ran to the little boy and hugged him.
"Chu Li likes the young master."
…
"Chu Li, pack your things and let's go. This home can't accommodate me, so I don't want to stay here any longer." The young man shouted angrily as soon as he entered the door.
"Master, what's wrong?" The girl saw the boy rushing in angrily.
"They wanted to deprive me of my identity as heir, but grandpa remained silent. Silence is acquiescence. I have nothing to miss about this family. Since they all want me to leave, I will show them my ways." The young man said angrily.
The girl packed her things and the two secretly left the family.
…
"Chu Li, here can weIs there anyone living there? "The boy looked at the slum and asked, covering his nose.
“Master, we didn’t bring any money when we went out, so now we have to live here. "The girl explained.
"Okay... okay, then Chu Li, you sent me here, and you can go back. This is too shabby, how can you, a girl, live here. "
"Chu Li will not go anywhere. Wherever the young master is, Chu Li will be there. As long as Chu Li is here, he will always follow the young master. "The girl promised the boy like this.
…
The scenes of the past were now extremely clear before Changsun's eyes.
